note: Actual candidate, approval, native-dimension and rights records only. Empty means none exist.

humanRulings.authority: human (repository owner) via Arena gate answer (option normalize)
humanRulings.decision: Resolve the standing 2048/3072 promotion ruling: normalize within bounds, then promote. Same-aspect <=2x Lanczos upscale to profile targets (1024^2 -> 2048^2), glyph-class 1024^2 downscaled to the 512^2 REF-GLYPH spec, title 1456x720 normalized to 2048x1024 via height-exact resize + ~1.1% center crop (center-safe by spec, <=2% bound). Sheets that cannot reach target within bounds (native aspect mismatch >1%, or required scale >2x) stay candidates: HELD pending fresh canonical-resolution passes or an explicit as-is instruction.

humanRulings.authority: human (repository owner) via Arena gate answer (option keepblocked)
humanRulings.decision: B00 dimensional BLOCK is FINAL: the 3072x2048 style board is not generated; CG-S-ART-DIRECTION remains NO_AMENDMENT_RUN_STOPPED; the B01-era set remains the provisional style anchor of record.

humanRulings.authority: human (repository owner), reply "go on" to the completion report presenting the two recorded exits for the 14 HELD sheets
humanRulings.decision: Authorize the first recorded exit: fresh canonical-resolution passes for the 14 HELD IDs (per-ID 1+1 budgets), each success normalizing within bounds under ruling CANONICAL_PROMOTION_NORMALIZE_WITHIN_BOUNDS. The as-is promotion exit was NOT selected. Sheets that still cannot reach their profile targets within bounds after their pass remain HELD with dispositions intact.

humanRulings.authority: human (repository owner) via Arena gate answer (option asis)
humanRulings.decision: Promote the 9 content-conforming landscape sheets (CG-S-INF-BRIDGE, CG-S-INF-CANAL, CG-S-INF-MINE, CG-S-INF-WALL, CG-S-INF-ROAD, CG-S-INF-FARM, CG-S-GOD-LIFE-H, CG-S-GOD-LIFE-M, CG-S-GOD-LIFE-Q) to canonical AS-IS at native 1264x848 with per-receipt deviation disclosures. The TB-08 model canvas ceiling (14/14) makes 3072x2048 unreachable; owner accepts the documented deviation.

humanRulings.authority: human (repository owner) via FINAL ARENA CLOSURE PASS instruction document
humanRulings.decision: One bounded fresh pass for CG-S-GOD-LIFE-S: use accepted CG-S-GOD-FORM-S identity (lateral crop anchor, no failed-sheet image anchors), exactly six states in one 3x2 sheet, ossuary S-family-specific (low long axial ribbon framework, no generic tall-domed/toothed vertebrate skull), 1 initial + 1 targeted repair; content-conforming result at 1264x848 may be promoted AS-IS with prominent deviation recording; if both fail, mark honestly unresolved and report LIFE-S as the sole remaining asset blocker. B00_BLOCK_FINAL remains in force. Outcome: r003 REJECTED, r004 REJECTED - LIFE-S unresolved.

ownerRulings.ruling: Reopen B00: lift B00_BLOCK_FINAL and require a new compliant art-direction board before M03 can be accepted.
ownerRulings.effect: CG-S-ART-DIRECTION stays absent until Arena delivers a compliant board; M03 cannot be accepted before it is approved.

ownerRulings.ruling: FORM-Q r004 is anatomically authoritative. Q does not have the LIFE-Q shell; LIFE-Q r005 is continuity drift and must be corrected/replaced to match FORM-Q.
ownerRulings.effect: CG-S-GOD-LIFE-Q r005 remains the Arena canonical file but no longer scores or shapes FORM-Q; a corrected LIFE-Q is required from Arena.

ownerRulings.ruling: The FORM-Q top view is binding. Reshape the 3D body until it satisfies the top-view reference while preserving the already-passing front/rear identity.
ownerRulings.effect: Executed as the single bounded M03 repair pass (revision c003).

ownerRulings.topic: Six M03 c002 models / human art gate
ownerRulings.ruling: The model direction is visually acceptable in principle, but final c002 approval remains conditional on seeing the actual c002 outputs.
ownerRulings.effect: No model is INTEGRATED_VERIFIED; human art approval remains pending.

ownerRulings.ruling: Keep the working tree uncommitted until my decisions above are applied; then commit and push the resolved M03 state in one bounded change.
ownerRulings.effect: One commit and push after the rulings are applied.

historicalRulings.statement: I approve of the life stages sheet as well as I accept the um we can do the ten twenty-four sheets and um regarding the art style we're gonna do what it makes and we'll adjust from that. Um I am approving the identity option.
supersededBy: B00_BLOCK_FINAL (2026-09-24): CG-S-ART-DIRECTION stays absent; the earlier intake of r001 is withdrawn.

CANONICAL_PROMOTION_NORMALIZE_WITHIN_BOUNDS (2026-09-24) and AS_IS_PROMOTION_HELD_LANDSCAPE_NINE (2026-09-24): canonical B01 bytes are the Arena-promoted files, not the native candidates this ruling accepted.
LIFE-Q: the Arena ledger records r002 as REJECTED; r005 is the canonical source. The r002 3x3 panel map is withdrawn.
